judge.rationale: The candidate correctly implements `accumulateUsage` across tool rounds, handles missing per-round usage without returning `undefined` or `NaN`, updates `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`, and includes comprehensive unit and acceptance tests. However, it misses the explicit acceptance criterion to make the `afterModelResponse` signature itself unambiguous (even after identifying this in its own DoD facet), leaving the parameter named `usage` in `OrchestratorHooks` (`src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`, `CLAUDE.md`, and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`) and leaving the local variable in `chatOrchestrator.ts` misleadingly named `lastUsage` instead of renaming both to `totalUsage` like the reference. Additionally, it places tests in a new `chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` file and leaves `.lore/dod.md` in the diff rather than extending `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`.
